sources.label: Official General Aptitude syllabus · IIT Madras

subjects.name: General Aptitude
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Verbal, quantitative, analytical, and spatial aptitude.
topics: Interpreting graphs, plots, maps, and tables
Deduction, induction, analogy, and numerical reasoning
Spatial transformations, folding, cutting, and patterns

subjects.name: Engineering Mathematics
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Discrete mathematics, linear algebra, calculus, and probability.
topics: Sets, functions, relations, partial orders, and lattices
Matrices, determinants, linear systems, and LU decomposition
Limits, continuity, differentiation, and the mean value theorem
Mean, median, mode, and standard deviation

subjects.name: Digital Logic
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Logic simplification, circuits, and number representation.
topics: Fixed-point and floating-point representation and arithmetic

subjects.name: Computer Organization & Architecture
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Processor design, memory systems, I/O, and pipelines.
topics: Memory interfacing, hierarchy, cache mapping, and performance

subjects.name: Programming & Data Structures
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · C programming and the structures used to organize data.

subjects.name: Algorithms
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Complexity, design techniques, and graph algorithms.
topics: Worst-case asymptotic time and space analysis

subjects.name: Theory of Computation
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Automata, formal languages, and computability.
topics: Pushdown automata and context-free pumping arguments

subjects.name: Compiler Design
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Translation stages, runtime organization, and optimization.
topics: Data-flow analysis: constants, liveness, and common subexpressions

subjects.name: Operating Systems
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Processes, synchronization, scheduling, memory, and files.

subjects.name: Databases
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Data models, querying, normalization, indexing, and transactions.
topics: File organization and B/B+ tree indexing

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS · Layering, switching, routing, IPv4, TCP, and network services.
topics: Layering, switching methods, and performance metrics
Link-layer error detection, MAC, and Ethernet
